sentences.text:
Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. Vaibhav Pandit, Advocate
 (through video conferencing).

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief
 Holder.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

This Application has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.132 of 2025, registered at Police Station Rishikesh, District Dehradun under Sections 120-B, 420, 467, 468 and Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
According to the First Information Report dated 09.03.2025, lodged by the informant Rajendra Singh Sajwan, the co-accused were not the owners of the property-in-question.
Despite this, they sold the property.
Applicant was also involved in the said fake transaction.
3. Heard Mr. Vaibhav Pandit, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
4. Mr. Vaibhav Pandit, Advocate, contended that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present matter.
He did not prepare any forged document.
He did not play any fraud with the informant.
He is a permanent resident of District Dehradun and he has no criminal antecedents.
5. Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief Holder, has requested, on instructions, three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.
